arn.text: The Suwwardi captured Mishra in the Great Desert and took his Weakstone, making him a rakiq.
When a giant mechanical dragon rose from the sands and slew the Qadir, Mishra retrieved the Weakstone and found he could control it.

At a peace summit, Mishra's Weakstone overloaded Urza's automaton, and at a second summit Mishra convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone, and Urza reclaimed it and declared war, starting the Brothers' War.

atq.text: As children, Urza and Mishra went with their master Tocasia to the sacred cave of Koilos, where Mishra discovered the Weakstone while Urza found the Mightstone in the Hall of Tagsin.
The stone split into the Mightstone and Weakstone, each brother craved both, and their rivalry led to a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death.
Later, Mishra and Ashnod used the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world where the Yawgmoth Demon attacked and followed them back.
